participation.context: Sat to the board with the chronicle shut.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the second volume at the side of the board and did not open it.

title: Set the chronicle at the side of the board

participation.context: Wrote the first sheet's opening and stopped inside it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You put the hall on the sheet, and the crown, and the line that gives it. You did not open the chronicle.

title: Wrote the crown in two hands

participation.context: Wrote the couplet and left the rest of the sheet empty.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set down the two lines in which he washes off the balm and gives away the crown with his own hands. You did not go on to the prison.

title: Wrote the unmaking, item by item

participation.context: Wrote the glass in three beats and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You finished the third sheet at the glass and did not start another. You stayed in the chair.

title: Broke the glass on the page

participation.context: Left the three sheets on the board.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You spoke once about the cat and did not move the sheets into the coffer.

title: Left the sheets under the cat
